[[Prince/Legends|Crown Prince]] '''Gaul Panteer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the heir to the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Throne/Legends|throne]] as the son of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Silara Panteer]], and the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].

==Biography==
During the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Great Galactic War, after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] [[Battle of Alderaan|invasion]] of Alderaan, he and other [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] leaders became voices of military action in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], contrary to the famous historic peaceful stance of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. As senator, he voted for Alderaan to secede from the Galactic Republic after the controversial [[Treaty of Coruscant]] was signed. Alderaanians who opposed leaving the Republic were outraged, but many supported his decision.

He was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by a member of [[House Rist]] (who was working for [[House Ulgo]]) not long after he made his controversial decision; Queen Silara [[Death/Legends|died]] days later in a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crash in the [[Glarus Valley]]. With no undisputed heir to the throne, Alderaan was dragged into a [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] between several noble houses.

==Behind the scenes==
Gaul appears in the mission "Red Handed" for Republic classes in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. His appearances occurs only in a hologram recording.
